description: A poll's runs, newest first: when each was due, started and finished, its status and counts, and available_at, when this reader could first have read it. A stranger sees only runs that have become available; the owner also sees queued and running ones, and charges. (GET /api/v1/polls/{id}/runs)

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, unchanged.

id.description: The poll's id, or its public address (slug).
